title: Professional Certificate Course in Understanding Business Environment and Relationships
description: The aim of the course is to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the various factors that shape the business environment and the different relationships that businesses have with their stakeholders.
longDescription: Understand the Legal Business Framework Learn about Stakeholder’s nature, engagement and analysis Understand the Logistics, imports and Exports aspects of a business The course "Understanding Business Environment and Relationships" aims to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the various factors that shape the business environment and the different relationships that businesses have with their stakeholders. courseDetails: The course "Business Environment and Relationships" is designed to provide students with an understanding of the various factors that influence the business environment, including economic, social, political, legal, and technological factors. Students will also learn about businesses' different relationships with their stakeholders, including customers, suppliers, competitors, employees, and the community. The course typically covers market structures, economic indicators, government policies and regulations, corporate social responsibility, and business ethics. Students will also learn how to analyze and interpret financial statements and apply various analytical tools and techniques to make informed business decisions.
